correctness.rationale: Every block-reversal output has at most m initial/final zeros because the last/first blocks are suffix/prefix and the source maximum zero-run length is m. For arbitrary admissible p,q,r,s the explicit five-piece decomposition with i=max(0,q-(m-p)) and j=m-p+i-q is well-defined and reverses to the output. Stars-and-bars with disjoint violations gives C(2m+3,3)-2*C(m+2,3)=(m+1)^3 for all m>=0. Independent enumeration checks exact output sets for m=0..7; not used as proof.

value.rationale: The exact set equality is a natural complete reachability classification for a periodic sparse binary family in an established multi-block rearrangement model. Its nonobvious sufficiency shows that two endpoint zero-run bounds encode all possible outputs, giving the infinite cube law and a limiting attainable density of 3/4. This supplies a structural explanation, not an arbitrary small census or generic stars-and-bars fact.
